parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the door of the safe, made of steel, forming the front protective barrier of the object.
parts.Functional_description: The door secures the contents of the safe and can be opened or closed to allow or restrict access.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the switch or handle mechanism of the safe, made of steel, located on the door.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to lock or unlock the door mechanism, allowing the user to secure or open the safe.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or turns to engage or disengage the locking mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the safe, made of thick steel, forming the structural enclosure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the main protective housing for the safe’s contents, resisting external force and tampering.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal operation.
